B1d room popheads (order 97, contrary room) reread: A1 note, 18 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (251 threads, 1,906 items, 1,466 dropped; most threads are one-post April Fools fakes, one 169-item flair thread and a reply chain of one member singing a lyric line by line, all uncoded). Two placements moved, each with a tier_history line: t04 (readers falling for and spotting the room's own fake releases) from T3-095 to T3-001, by the B1b-20 rule, which came after this room was read at B1b-05; t18 (one call to write r/popheads on the canvas) from T3-002 to T3-169 signing the sub's name. No new kind. The forest bears out the A1 note: the sax was planned in one thread and taken to Discord (630tyu, 630bxg), and its organiser declined to rebuild for lack of hands. The four B1c ideas do not show here. Rooms read before B1b-20 may hold more April Fools themes in T3-095 that the rule sends to T3-001; for B1e.

B1d room cirkeltrek (order 116, contrary room) reread: A1 note, 11 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (some 250 threads, most a single member's call). Grouping move: T3-188 (disowning rogue offshoots of the work, until now ainbowroad t10 alone) rescoped to hold the doing the B1c idea 'conceding placers ignore the plan' named: an organised room telling others it does not control placers acting in its name. Prompted by c0306 here ('We have no control over our people so this can probably not be stopped. Get out while you can', to the Armenians). Placed: cirkeltrek t08 (c0306) as an additional kind beside T3-010; polska t10 (from T3-125 and T3-126, now T3-188 with T3-087); PlaceNL t11 (from T3-126 and T3-087, now T3-188 with T3-049); denmark t13 (T3-188 added beside T3-126). Five tier_history lines (members_changed for T3-125, T3-126 and T3-087, rescoped for T3-188, label at B1e 'separating the plan from placers it cannot control'); four rule 0 lines. Not a new kind: a mint was weighed and set aside because the road's rogue-shard disowning is the same doing. c0302 (too many people do not follow the plan) sits in t05, which already holds three kinds; for B1e. National content read plainly: annexation calls on Greece, Armenia, Turkey, Croatia, Czechia and Indonesia; the Armenian genocide invoked for the takeover (c0170, c0174); MH17 proposed for the Russian flag (c0208); slurs for Greeks and Germans (c0088, c0255); VOC colonising.

B1d room kurdistan (order 117 by the chosen list's seeded order, group 1, the B1c test found a gate failing in t02) reread: A1 note, 6 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (7 threads, 43 items). Added: t02 T3-006 (c0015, 'If we're too few to create a Kurdish one, the least we can do (and easily achieve) is sabotage theirs', of the Turkish flag), beside T3-068 and T3-130; t03 T3-024 (c0013, the member held back from placing the sun on the flag because it was the Hungarians' work), beside T3-010 and T3-132. Two rule 0 lines written. The B1c gate failure on t02 (which label takes replacing another nation's flag with one's own) is a discriminator owed at B1e, not a new kind: T3-068 when the room turns the other's work into its own mark (the Hungarian flag with a sun, the Turkish flag with the PYD's), T3-006 when it calls to deface without making its own, T3-061 when it pushes into space without converting; T3-130 carries the national choice of target. t03's T3-132 label names a Discord and the watching here was in the sub's thread: already among the B1e name changes. t04 is bagged under T3-062 (would need T3-014, T3-099, T3-069); two more kinds have concepts of their own, T3-005 (c0027 defending the YPG and Rojava flags from 'Italian fascists', c0036) and T3-011 (c0025, c0026, c0041, going to help r/TheFarLeftSide's flag); write4 does not write a second bag for the same kept kind, so they are recorded here for B1e. t06 stays T3-095: the Turkmen statement's poster is deleted and nothing shows the room staged it, so the B1b-20 rule's T3-001 does not apply. National content read plainly: the statement that Turkmen nationalists in South Kurdistan be registered and Turkmen flags banned (c0022); the Turkish flag chosen as target and the Greeks' replacement of it (c0014, c0018); PKK, YPG and Rojava flags; relying on 'the Russians' (c0035). No new kind; the run is not reset. c0030 (pointing out the PKK flag above the YPG) is remarking on pictures around the mark, T3-052, one concept; the B1c idea 'reporting the live canvas' is not met here.
